algorithm: Apply events in increasing revision order after verifying immutable conversation_id/frontier_id, parent_revision, previous_event_digest, and event_digest. Revision 5 binds every material reference and the active canonicalization/projection/manifest policies.

operations.FRONTIER_CREATED: Initialize identity, origin, objective, current question, base decision/path/question/constraint refs, next action ref, and status.
operations.FRONTIER_AMENDED: Add workstream and lineage/source registry references and additional open questions.
operations.FRONTIER_HARDENED: Add storage, restore, canonicalization, discovery, and status bindings.
operations.FRONTIER_HARDENED_OBJECTS: Add object registry, revision manifest, projection policy, and status bindings.
operations.FRONTIER_BINDING_COMPLETED: Add trajectory refs, preserved opportunity refs, forbidden assumption refs, implementation refs, active policy refs, and status bindings.

publication_boundary: Revision 5 is the first revision where every material field in FRONTIER_STATE is reconstructible from the event sequence without shadow semantic state.
